defect_reasons.contradictory_distractor_statement: Every variant gives two different values for the same disconnected workbench resistor (e.g. 47 ohm and then 94 ohm), so the item contradicts itself even though the answer V = 0.3 A x 100.0 ohm = 30 V is unaffected.

counterexamples: Variant 1: 'a disconnected 47 ohm resistor' followed by 'A later note reports this same quantity as 94 ohm instead' - two values for one quantity.
notes: Answer in all four variants is 30 V (current 0.3 A given to one significant figure; 30 V at that precision). The disconnected resistor has no path to the target, but the parenthetical note is a self-contradiction, which under rule 2 makes the item invalid.
